title: CHGR Governance Record Provenance
description: Artifact classification: Evidentiary. Answers 'what happened, in order, to produce this record' (CHGR-001 Sec.10). Provenance, standing alone or together with integrity evidence, never establishes that a recorded decision is currently authoritative (CHGR-REQ-089).

template_used_ref.description: Which Decision Template version was in force (CHGR-REQ-088).

options_presented.description: The full closed option-id set actually presented (CHGR-REQ-084).

selected_option_id.description: What was selected (CHGR-REQ-084). Must match the referencing HumanGovernanceRecord's own selected_option_id (checked at verification, not schema).

rationale_given.description: Optional copy of the rationale actually supplied, if any.

preview_content_digest.description: Digest of the exact preview content the human actually confirmed (CHGR-REQ-085). Must match the sibling HumanConfirmationEvidence's own preview_rendering_digest.

confirmation_event_ref.description: Reference to the confirmation event this provenance describes (CHGR-REQ-086).

available.description: Whether repository/commit provenance is disclosed below. false when unavailable -- never guessed or fabricated to fill the gap.

commit_hash.description: Present only when available is true.

branch.description: Present only when available is true.

repository_provenance.description: The repository/commit provenance of the record's own files (CHGR-REQ-083, CHGR-001 Sec.10). A commit's presence is never evidence of what was decided, only of when/where the record's files existed.

extensions.description: Controlled additive extension container. Empty object permitted.
